description: Public IP geolocation map. Choose Source or Destination. GeoIP: DB-IP Lite via ClickHouse geoip_trie. Private RFC1918 excluded. Attribution: https://db-ip.com (CC BY 4.0)

panels.description: Public IPs aggregated by city (Source or Destination per variable). Marker size = traffic. IP Geolocation by DB-IP https://db-ip.com

targets.query:
SELECT
    latitude,
    longitude,
    if(city = '', country, concat(country, ' / ', city)) AS place,
    sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS traffic,
    count() AS flows
FROM
(
    SELECT
        bytes,
        sampling_rate,
        dictGet('geoip_trie', 'latitude', ip) AS latitude,
        dictGet('geoip_trie', 'longitude', ip) AS longitude,
        dictGet('geoip_trie', 'country_code', ip) AS country,
        dictGet('geoip_trie', 'city', ip) AS city
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            bytes,
            sampling_rate,
            reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(${direction}), 13, 4)) AS ip
        FROM $table
        WHERE $timeFilter
          AND etype = 2048
          AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(${direction}), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
          AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(${direction}), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
          AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(${direction}), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
          AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(${direction}), 13, 4))), '127.0.0.0/8')
          AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(${direction}), 13, 4))), '169.254.0.0/16')
          AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(${direction}), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10')
    )
)
WHERE (latitude != 0 OR longitude != 0) AND country != ''
GROUP BY latitude, longitude, place
ORDER BY traffic DESC
LIMIT 500

SELECT
    country,
    sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS traffic,
    count() AS flows,
    uniqExact(ip) AS public_ips
FROM
(
    SELECT
        bytes,
        sampling_rate,
        ip,
        dictGet('geoip_trie', 'country_code', ip) AS country
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            bytes,
            sampling_rate,
            reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(${direction}), 13, 4)) AS ip
        FROM $table
        WHERE $timeFilter
          AND etype = 2048
          AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(${direction}), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
          AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(${direction}), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
          AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(${direction}), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
          AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(${direction}), 13, 4))), '127.0.0.0/8')
          AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(${direction}), 13, 4))), '169.254.0.0/16')
          AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(${direction}), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10')

)

SELECT
    IPv4NumToString(ip) AS public_ip,
    country,
    city,
    sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS traffic,
    count() AS flows
FROM
(
    SELECT
        bytes,
        sampling_rate,
        ip,
        dictGet('geoip_trie', 'country_code', ip) AS country,
        dictGet('geoip_trie', 'city', ip) AS city
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            bytes,
            sampling_rate,
            reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(${direction}), 13, 4)) AS ip
        FROM $table
        WHERE $timeFilter
          AND etype = 2048
          AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(${direction}), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
          AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(${direction}), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
          AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(${direction}), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
          AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(${direction}), 13, 4))), '127.0.0.0/8')
          AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(${direction}), 13, 4))), '169.254.0.0/16')
          AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(${direction}), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10')
    )
)
WHERE country != ''
GROUP BY public_ip, country, city
ORDER BY traffic DESC
LIMIT 50
